held.title: Ad hoc filters and template variables may now be applied twice per query.
held.body: Each target now goes through `applyTemplateVariables(query, scopedVars, request.filters)` here, but the sub-requests still carry `request.filters` and `scopedVars`. If `datasource.runQuery` goes through `DataSourceWithBackend.query` (I couldn't check this from the diff), that path calls `applyTemplateVariables` again on every target. In that case each ad hoc filter is added to the expression a second time (e.g. `{a="b", c="d", c="d"}` or a doubled `| c="d"` stage). The already-substituted text also gets interpolated again, so a variable value that contains a literal `$name` would be replaced a second time. The updated shard test expecting 5 `applyTemplateVariables` calls suggests the function already runs more than once per query. Fix: after interpolating up front, clear `filters` on the sub-requests (or skip the second interpolation for split requests). The same applies to `shardQuerySplitting.ts` line 52.
